name: lumi-skill-cad-drafting
description: Source-verified CAD tracing with staged geometry extraction, receipt-based handoff, resumable visible AutoCAD MCP playback, and exact entity-count verification.

lumi.setupNote: Image geometry must pass staged extraction and source comparison before the server issues an executable receipt. Visible AutoCAD playback verifies operation identity and entity deltas, resumes interrupted runs in the same document, and has no generated-file, LISP, SCRIPT, batch-command, or cursor fallback. Production drawings still require professional verification.
